title: Field trip closes tonight
scenario: A message in a parent chat says the school’s field-trip payment portal is down and shares a new payment link that expires tonight. Several parents react with thumbs-up emojis.

answers.A: Pay because other parents appear to be using it and the deadline is real.
answers.B: Use the school portal or a known school contact to confirm the payment method before paying.
answers.C: Ask the chat admin or another parent you know personally whether the school announced a new link.

explanation: Group-chat momentum can make a fake link feel community-approved. The school’s own channel should confirm any payment change.
proTip: Crowd confidence is not payment verification.
